d:
Scott Kuggeleijn’s fiery spell powers Sudurpaschim Royals to a commanding 27-run victory!
Batting first, the Royals posted 120/9, with Brandon McMullen scoring 33 off 23 balls and Tharindu Ratnayake adding a crucial unbeaten 27. Janakpur’s Harmeet Singh impressed with a brilliant 4/17.
In reply, the Bolts struggled against a disciplined Royals bowling attack, with Scott Kuggeleijn leading the charge with 3/13 to bowl them out for 93 and seal a 27-run win!
